title: Density Formula
text: Density is mass per unit volume: $$\rho=\frac{m}{V}, $$ where $$\rho$$ is the density, $$m$$ is the mass, and $$V$$ is the volume occupied by the substance.

title: Identify the Densities of the Constituents
text: We take the density of gold $$\rho_{\text{gold}}=19.32\,\text{g/cm}**3,$$ the density of silver $$\rho_{\text{silver}}=10.1\,\text{g/cm}**3,$$ and the density of copper $$\rho_{\text{copper}}=8.8\,\text{g/cm}**3$$.

title: Formula for the Average Density
text: The average density of a mixture by mass is found from $$\frac{1}{\rho}=\frac{m_{g}/M}{\rho_{\text{gold}}}+\frac{m_{s}/M}{\rho_{\text{silver}}}+\frac{m_{c}/M}{\rho_{\text{copper}}},$$ where $$M$$ is the total mass and $$m_{g},$$ $$m_{s},$$ and $$m_{c}$$ are the masses of gold, silver, and copper.
